newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti falls in Milan on press talk.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti falls in Milan on press talk.

text.p: Olivetti fell on the Milan bourse on press reports of losses of over 50 billion lire at its Telemedia fixed-line telecoms company, which controls its Infostrada telecoms unit, and on reported remarks by GSM mobile phone operator Omnitel managing director Silvio Scaglia on possible difficulties of a break-even in 1998.
At 1225 GMT, Olivetti shares were 4.56 percent down at 578 lire in active trading after an opening 604 lire.
"For days now Olivetti stock has been falling on talk of a possible capital restructuring for Infostrada, and now worries are growing even more," one broker said.
Olivetti and France Telecom earlier this month signed a joint venture deal under which the French group would acquire 49 percent of Infostrada by subscribing to a 165 billion lire capital increase.
